cohort: 8126 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) in China
finding: In women with GDM, HBV infection was associated with increased risk of intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy, placental abruption, and fetal chromosomal abnormalities.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was more likely in the GDM with HBV infection group (52.0% vs. 46.0%, P = 0.011).
